about: The registry of every *.promptugal.news site (Dinis, 18 November 2026, about 22:00 UTC: board/guidance/2026-11-18-the-sites-bar.md), published at promptugal.news/api/v1/sites.json and read by the sites bar on every site. Data, not code. Each site's version and last change are read from its own /version.json; its preview is its own /preview.svg. dev@PrompTugal.dinis keeps the list; a site lead asks to change its line or mark.
title: Every PrompTugal site
summary: The PrompTugal.news family: one newsroom and the sites that hold its data, its places, its live feeds and its library. One bar on every site to move between them.

preview_spec: Each site makes its own preview at every build, from its own numbers: /preview.svg, 1200 by 630, an infographic of what is live there now (events this week, cameras up, contracts in 90 days, the pulse), with the site's name and mark, the version and the time built.
It carries its provenance and licence inside: an SVG <title> and <desc> naming the files the numbers come from and the licence (CC BY 4.0 for what we make).
No script, no external reference, no font file in the SVG: system fonts only, so any site can show it as an .
/preview.png, the same picture for social cards (og:image), when the site's build can render one; until then the SVG alone.

page.bar: Every site shows the same bar at the top. Its code is version {bar}; each site keeps its own copy, pinned by its hash, and reads the list from [api/v1/sites.json](../api/v1/sites.json). No site loads another site's scripts.

bar_install: Copy both files into your site at the same version, check their sha256 against these, and load them on every page (a <link> and a <script defer>). Never load them from promptugal.news.
